description: Canonical future-session pair and asset identity catalog. A/B are stable asset identities; screen position is randomized/counterbalanced separately per event. Every configured asset is bound to a repository path and SHA-256 before release.

asset_freeze_invariants.path: repository-relative canonical asset path; no traversal or remote URL
asset_freeze_invariants.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters matching exact file bytes
asset_freeze_invariants.mime_type: must match an allowed image MIME type and the canonical file extension
asset_freeze_invariants.identity: asset_a_id and asset_b_id are stable identities and must differ
asset_freeze_invariants.release: RELEASED requires at least one pair, content_status=FROZEN, released_at, and all assets passing the repository verifier
